entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: My apologies for the wait.[n]That was quite the line.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The staff here is amazing though.[n]I only asked for directions, but[n]they gave me such a bright smile...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Just watching them work[n]lifts my spirits.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hm, it's almost noon... Shall we[n]go eat lunch? Is there anything[n]in particular you'd like?
How about ramen?
Hamburg steak!
I'll leave it to you.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sure! I think that shop[n]is in the Adventure Area...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* That's a standard,[n]but still a nice idea.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: A few restaurants have that.[n]Let's check the ones nearby[n]first, okay?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hmmm... How about a[n]seasonal prix fixe?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think there's a restaurant in[n]the Western Area that has one...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Okay. Let's come back here when[n]it's time for the parade!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mmm, that was so delicious!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It... makes me happy having[n]someone I can share my[n]meals with.
Let's eat together every day.[clr 27]
I'm happy too.[clr 27]
You can ask me out whenever.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Th-That almost sounds[n]like a proposal...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Though if that did happen...[n]I would surely enjoy it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: *giggle* Hearing that warms[n]my heart... I hope we can keep[n]spending time together like this.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thanks. I think I might just[n]take you up on that offer.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You know, a lot has been happening[n]lately... but right now I just[n]want to cherish my time with you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm so glad I have you, [fName]-kun...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I always lose track of time[n]when we're together... Come[n]on, let us return home.
